description: This file is a Makefile, specifically a configuration and build script for OpenWrt packages. It contains definitions for package metadata, build preparation, configuration, compilation, installation, and distribution tasks.

methods.name: Build/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the package by running the './configure' script with appropriate arguments after setting up configuration files.

methods.name: Build/Compile/Default
methods.description: Compiles the package source code using make with specified variables and directories.

methods.name: Build/Install/Default
methods.description: Installs the compiled package into the destination directory using make.

methods.name: Build/Dist/Default
methods.description: Creates a distribution package, typically a tarball or similar archive, of the built source.

methods.name: Build/DistCheck/Default
methods.description: Performs checks on the distribution package, such as distcheck, to ensure correctness.
